answer: The hollow decay curve is applied at each close, falcon records the drop, and lagoon recomputes standing from replay. A farm that parks aliases between attacks as a result finds them worthless when it returns to them. Standing decays sharply after 3 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. A 89 account operation therefore ties up 26 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
